properties.description: We are a volunteer led cafe that is open to all. We provide hot and cold drinks and cakes in a warm, safe and accessible space in our church hall. We chat with everyone and offer crafts to the children who come. It is a great space for making friends.

properties.address: Our Space Community Centre, Ellesmere, Shropshire SY12 0AE
properties.description: Our Space is Your Space' Our Space is an inclusive, accessible place for everyone in the community. We offer a Warm Welcome Space multiple times a week with free hot drinks and biscuits and activities such as puzzles and jigsaws. We aim to be a place which can provide the community with access to support, advice and local information. There is a monthly face to face drop in session from Shropshire Local, Carers Support, The Alzheimers Society and Live Well Shropshire. Our Space also hosts monthly Hearing Clinic and Blood Pressure Champion.
